versions.content: If the PDU Router module notifies the SecOC module that the destination lower layer module has either confirmed the transmission of the Secured I - PDU or reported an error during transmission by calling SecOC_[If|Tp]TxConfirmation , the SecOC module shall pass the received result of the respective Authentic I - PDU to the upper layer module by calling PduR_SecOC[If | Tp]T xConfirmation .
